notes.title: Astra 1.2_1 Patch
notes.notes:
Hi welcome to Astra 1.2_1 this is a small patch which improves and fixes some items.

Reworked airship model.

Reworked statue model.

Changed hidden achievement chance from 1:1000 to 1:100 as to make it more fair.

Fixed a bug with prop culling.

Changed the sword swing sound to make it more beefy.

Changed the hurt sounds for some enemies to better indicate a hit.

Thanks for the continued support <3

notes.title: ASTRA 1.2 Free content update out now!
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Knight of Waste free content update for ASTRA!

This update adds a new area/ quest to ASTRA as well as some other things. This content will automatically unlock after the boss is defeated or is re-defeated (in the case of those who have already completed the game) via the previously locked house in Cladworn which should unlock automatically.

Take to the Labruivanian wasteland and learn more about the Cult of Ilokor. 

_________________________________________________
Patchnotes:

Added volumetric lighting effects which can be toggled via the settings menu in-game.
Added Knight of Waste content:
New area.
New music.
New minigame.
New achievements.
Added more information to different shop items so the player can understand what these things do before purchasing.

Fixed some bugs here and there.
Improved stability. 
_________________________________________________

I plan to continue supporting this game thanks for all the support!
(Sorry about the name I was so tired when I shipped the update lmao)
